title: Exotic Crunchy Moroccan Brussels Sprouts Seffa
description: A fermented one pot Moroccan dish featuring Brussels sprouts, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot and wrapped in corn husk, satvik friendly and in the form of seffa.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the halved Brussels sprouts and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the Brussels sprouts are tender.
Wrap the pot in corn husk and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pot for at least 24 hours to allow the flavors to meld and the Brussels sprouts to ferment.
Before serving, reheat the seffa over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
